📦 **Blocksail `c7e7fd1`** — fix: show smaller map icons for lower-population towns

Use population-based image slots28/32/36/40/44/48px across the six existing population tiers, retaining48px for the largest cities. Keep128px source PNGs. Placement reserves the matching name and hit bounds, with36px minimum click targets for small settlements. Port stems, docking underline/anchor and missing-image house scale together; upward name avoidance remains active.

Checks:20 population boundaries, actual six renderer sizes, real500->501->0 population,12 mixed-size markers and66 icon/name pairs, Jamaica3-town layout,5 hit controls, missing-image fallback, inline script parse. Actual IAB globe screenshot in docs/evidence/citylogos1076/population-size.png. No battle rebuild or Blockside working changes included.

Refs TASK-1076

👥 參與者：@meadow
